page.layout: One printed page with a running head at the top; central text block; small marginal notes in the right margin beside the text; a fragment of a neighbouring page at the far left edge (not transcribed).

main_text.p: quia rationem, ob quam ita sint, ignorat, id est manu, qua capiat ista, destituitur. Quo igitur isti mihi in scientiis avidi, creduli, prurientes? Avem illam, Veritatem, aucupantur: & manibus, quibus eam præhendant, truncati, somniis illam captant, & possident in aëre: Nota nobis paræmia, o Belgæ, Avem in cælo habere, nihil habere est.
main_text.head: Textus V.
main_text.p: Hinc omnium fraudi-bus infesti sumus: & primò sensuum, sed hu remissumSensus nostros non sugillo: Circumscriptores illi quidem; sed, & singuli stolidi, & universi malè fœderati: mutua consilia non rarò, mutuos astus eludunt: Patent, tenentur: Jam pridem iis dica scripta, & palam fraudis mendaciisque convictis, fides abrogata.

page.notes: The marginal notes at the right are small italic and partly damaged; their reading ("Hine omnium fraudibus infesti sumus: & primò sensuum, sed hu remissum") is doubtful, especially "hu re-missum". The left-edge fragment belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. The head "Textus V." is set in a larger italic and is treated as a level 2 heading.
